title: Always sign before publishing
content: The `publish` target requires the `.signed` marker to run. It was missing, so `make sign publish` was used to ensure publishing could proceed.

title: Never edit generated files
content: Files under `generated/` are overwritten by the build process and should not be manually edited.

title: SQLite NOT NULL columns need defaults for existing rows
content: Adding a `NOT NULL` column to a table with existing rows in SQLite requires a default value, otherwise it will fail. The `owner` column was fixed by adding `DEFAULT ''`.

title: Fix migration by adding default to NOT NULL column
content: To resolve the migration error, the `owner` column in `schema.sql` was modified to include `DEFAULT ''`, allowing existing rows to be populated with an empty string.

title: No deploy step in Makefile
content: The `make publish` command does not include a deploy step, so the eu-west region was not affected by the release.
